image_prompt.text: Snow piles and frozen supply crates as waist-high (3-4 studs) and full-body (7-8 studs) cover, distributed evenly across the open ground between the buildings
Two staging bases of cold steel and ice at opposite ends of the outpost, walled and roofed so neither is open to a sniper line
Narrow gaps between the ice walls and the steel buildings where approach routes converge, concentrating fights into contested ground
A tall communications tower crowned with antenna arrays, its sniper nest reachable only by exposed, predictable stairs and ladders
Cold steel military buildings with frost-covered roofs, spaced apart across the outpost but kept close enough for fast FPS combat flow
Thick ice walls and chain-link fencing forming the perimeter of the base
Radar dishes and antenna array installations planted around the compound
Large ice crystals growing out of the frozen ground between the structures
Microdetail pass: icicles hanging from the structures, frost patches on metal surfaces, snow drifts, frozen footprints, and small ice formations

layout_placement.text: Balanced team spawns at opposite ends of the arctic base, completely shielded from enemy sniper lines

notes: Preset Team Deathmatch kept, but on `open-battlefield` instead of the preset's `lane-network`: the prompt asks for structures spaced apart across one contiguous outpost, not parallel lanes. All three preset options were retained.

`cover-elevated` added on top of the preset for the tall communications tower - in a sniper game that is the elevated firing position. Read as tiered with no overhang, so the route is `P0 + tiered` rather than `P2`.
Not MilSim despite the realistic military framing: no one-life squad raid, no room-clearing sequence, and the prompt asks for close combat flow, so `breach-sequence` was ruled out.
No interiors were requested - the buildings read as exterior cover and breach-facades - so `building-interior` was left out and the build stays off P3.

Palette and finish (cold blue-white and military green, frost and ice effects, realistic AAA look) are art direction rather than layout picks; carried inside the option text instead of as separate picks.
No Universal Option fired: no water body (everything is frozen), no islands, no stated landform relief, no ambient population.

would have asked: Sounds like a team deathmatch arena on an arctic military outpost - two shielded spawn bases at opposite ends, snow piles and frozen supply crates for cover, pinch points between the buildings and ice walls, plus the comms tower as an elevated sniper perch, all on one open map rather than fixed lanes. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: is this team-versus-team or free-for-all? Two opposing bases were taken from the preset; the prompt never says how many sides there are.
would have asked: should any of the steel buildings or the comms tower be enterable and breachable? That would need interiors generated separately, which is a slower build and not ready yet.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
